sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
International applicants, including noncitizens already on a U.S. visa, apply through Global Education Office
plus departmental review. The department describes a bachelor’s-to-PhD route, so a completed UChicago
mathematics bachelor’s is appropriate in principle; exact individual GPA/preparation approval remains
unverified. [s2] [s18]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Arts & Sciences > Mathematics & Statistics > Mathematics, prepare letter of intent and three referees,
and indicate assistantship interest in the letter. International review must be completed before departmental
selection. After admission, accept and provide financial/official academic records for immigration
documentation. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior adviser agreement appears on the mathematics checklist. Questions:
mathstatgradprogram@unm.edu. Current tenure-stream faculty fit below differs materially from older lists that
treat Buium as active. [s2] [s11]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
International FAQ permits replacing/adding application documents and updating recommenders in the portal.
International initial review normally takes 5-7 business days; departmental review timing varies. Exact
invitation trigger and receipt display are not explained publicly in the reviewed general pages. [s4]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Department deadline is recurring; central Fall 2027 dates were visible only in a search-index extract whose live
URL returned different content. Funding minimum is 2026-27, not a 2027-28 offer. [s1] [s8] [s10]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration; Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Department requires a completed fall application by February 15; no year/time zone specified. Amigo
scholarship best consideration also requires all materials by February 15. No separate reference grace period is
published. [s1] [s2] [s9]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required English scores should be received by February 15 for departmental and scholarship consideration.
GRE is optional. No distinct score grace period is published. [s1] [s9]
Supporting documents [Conflict]
Complete the departmental file by February 15. A search-index central table explicitly lists Fall 2027

U.S.-transfer application May 1 and documents July 1 (other international documents June 1), but opening that
URL shows an older English page instead. Treat those later dates as unconfirmed indexed evidence, not an
extension of math’s deadline. Official transcripts are required after admission. [s1] [s4] [s10]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Graduate minima: TOEFL 79/revised 4.5, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 105, PTE 53, TOEFL Essentials C1, Cambridge C2
or PTE Express 85. TOEFL code 4845. Medium-of-instruction certificates are expressly not accepted as a test
substitute. TA applicants may face additional departmental requirements. [s3] [s10]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A bachelor’s from a regionally accredited U.S. institution exempts the test, so a completed UChicago degree
qualifies. In-progress degree timing is not explicit. Another exception is two qualifying U.S.
freshman-composition semesters with C or higher, graded A-F; UChicago humanities equivalence is not
established. [s3]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required. No public indication that optional scores are ignored or prohibited. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required; if sending GRE scores, the department recommends the Mathematics Subject test. This is a
preference among submitted scores, not a stated mandatory test. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters, at least two from PhD faculty (department wording); central checklist says two from a PhD.
Choose academic PhD faculty to satisfy both. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
International Amigo is automatic with no separate application paperwork: nonimmigrant visa holders in
full-time degree study, no previous UNM study at that degree level, undergraduate GPA at least 3.0. It reduces
tuition to resident rate, valued over USD 15,000/year; it is not cash. February 15 best-consideration deadline.
No extra essay/reference specified; listed scholarships cannot be stacked. [s9]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission; Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
International FAQ explicitly says recommendation letters and recommenders can be updated in the applicant
portal, and uploaded documents can be replaced/added. It does not establish cross-cycle reuse or whether an
already submitted confidential letter can be edited by its author. [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Department stipend page is explicitly 2014-15 (USD 8,646/semester, 12 tuition credits and insurance), so it is
obsolete. Central 2026-27 minimum for 50% pre-master’s TA is USD 9,953.18 per 18-week term; two terms
total USD 19,906.36 by arithmetic. Post-master’s minimum is USD 10,949.27/term. These are university
minimums, not a confirmed math offer or 2027-28 rate. [s7] [s8]
Years of support [Standing rule]
No fixed PhD funding guarantee is established. Department FAQ’s estimated five-to-seven-year
bachelor’s-to-PhD completion time is not a funding promise. TA positions are offered as resources allow. [s7]
[s18]
International eligibility; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
International students may receive assistantships. Central rules: appointments lasting over half a semester
provide health insurance; at least 10 hours/week over half a semester qualifies for resident tuition. Some
appointments additionally cover tuition/fees; exact benefits are offer-dependent. [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Indicate assistantship interest in the required letter of intent. No additional incoming TA application is listed.
[s1] [s2]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
International Amigo is automatic with no separate application paperwork: nonimmigrant visa holders in
full-time degree study, no previous UNM study at that degree level, undergraduate GPA at least 3.0. It reduces
tuition to resident rate, valued over USD 15,000/year; it is not cash. February 15 best-consideration deadline.
No extra essay/reference specified; listed scholarships cannot be stacked. [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International graduate application USD 70; domestic USD 60. [s5]

Fee waiver [Conflict]
Graduate Studies says its central waivers do not cover international applications. International Admissions
separately says some graduate departments may have waivers/coupons. Mathematics-specific availability,
criteria and process are not established: ask before paying. [s5] [s6]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Hunter Dinkins
Enumerative geometry and geometric representation theory: quiver varieties, quasimap counts, vertex
functions and mirror symmetry. [s12] [s13]
Current official UNM directory lists assistant professor; older seminar bio still described MIT postdoc. Confirm new-student
availability.
Research evidence: 2026 · Wreath Macdonald polynomials, quiver varieties, and quasimap counts
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Janet Vassilev
Commutative algebra, singularities, closure operations and differential operators on semigroup rings. [s14] [s15]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2023; newer undated accepted article also listed · Differential operators, retracts, and toric face rings
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Alexandru Buium
Arithmetic differential geometry and Frobenius lifts. [s11] [s16]
Distinguished Professor Emeritus / retired; do not count as an ordinary available PhD adviser without explicit confirmation.
Research evidence: 2024 · Lie invariant Frobenius lifts
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Graduate minima: TOEFL 79/revised 4.5, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 105, PTE 53, TOEFL Essentials C1, Cambridge C2
or PTE Express 85. TOEFL code 4845. Medium-of-instruction certificates are expressly not accepted as a test
substitute. TA applicants may face additional departmental requirements. [s3] [s10]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A bachelor’s from a regionally accredited U.S. institution exempts the test, so a completed UChicago degree
qualifies. In-progress degree timing is not explicit. Another exception is two qualifying U.S.
freshman-composition semesters with C or higher, graded A-F; UChicago humanities equivalence is not
established. [s3]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required. No public indication that optional scores are ignored or prohibited. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required; if sending GRE scores, the department recommends the Mathematics Subject test. This is a
preference among submitted scores, not a stated mandatory test. [s1]
